n61c0eff52e.headline: Contributions to pension plans plunge 94% until June
n61c0eff52e.summary: Pension plan contributions fell 94% until June, but assets increased by 3.786 billion euros due to portfolio revaluation.
n61c0eff52e.why: Pension plans are key to retirement savings and financial markets; sharp drops in contributions may signal economic or demographic shifts.
